matrixPassages.text: The ten tiers correspond, knowingly or unknowingly, to the ten principles of existence.
Tier One: Possibility
Floors 1–10
The first tier produces uncertainty.

Paths divide. Rooms move. Doors respond differently to different travelers. The same decision does not always produce the same result. New arrivals encounter the dungeon as a field of unrealized futures.

The first floor serves as the dungeon’s principal point of entry, retreat, and regrouping. Escape magic can return adventurers there, but doing so ends their current descent and forces them to begin again. This is not simply a limitation of teleportation.
A possibility abandoned cannot be resumed as though it had never been abandoned.
The first Gate Guardian is The Bloom That Hungers.
Tier Two: Choice
Floors 11–20
Possibility means little without the ability to select among alternatives.
The second tier tests commitment, sacrifice, divided loyalty, and consequence. Its dangers often cannot be overcome without choosing what will be lost.
The second Gate Guardian is Vaskor, the Stone Maw.
Tier Three: Difference
Floors 21–30
The third tier reinforces distinction.

Self and enemy, truth and deception, original and imitation, living and dead—all are placed into conflict. Creatures that fail to preserve their distinctions may be altered, duplicated, absorbed, or replaced.
The third Gate Guardian is Ashthirst the Hollow.
Tier Four: Conflict
Floors 31–40
The fourth tier turns difference into opposition.
Its environments provoke territorial struggle, political division, predation, and war. It ensures that the dungeon’s inhabitants cannot settle permanently into universal agreement.
The fourth Gate Guardian is Choralith, Voice Below.
Tier Five: Motion
Floors 41–50
The fifth tier prevents stagnation.
Its geography shifts. Rivers reverse. Entire settlements migrate. Remaining still is often more dangerous than advancing. Every system within the tier is forced to move or perish.
The fifth Gate Guardian is Lumen of the Shattered Thread.
Tier Six: Time
Floors 51–60
The sixth tier regulates sequence and causality.

Time does not always pass evenly here. Some regions age rapidly, while others repeat moments or preserve ruins from eras that have not yet occurred. The tier prevents the dungeon from settling into a timeless state.
The sixth Gate Guardian is Threxus, the Iron Spiral.
The Known Civilizations
The first six tiers contain established small civilizations.

Some descend from expeditions trapped during previous openings. Others arose from settlements founded by survivors who accepted that they would never reach the surface again. A few may predate all surviving records.
These civilizations are not accidental contaminants within the dungeon’s design.
They are among its most effective resonance generators.

They form alliances, preserve histories, wage wars, worship gods, establish families, betray rulers, create art, and struggle to survive. Their continued existence produces precisely the complexity the prison requires.
Surface kingdoms know enough about these societies to trade with them, exploit them, recruit from them, or use them as staging grounds. Beyond the sixth tier, reliable records become scarce.
Past Floor 60, maps become contradictory.
Past Floor 70, history becomes uncertain.
Tier Seven: History
Floors 61–70
The seventh tier tests whether experience can survive distortion.
Records contradict one another. Ruins remember different builders. A person may encounter evidence of actions they never performed or lose memories that everyone else still possesses.
The seventh Gate Guardian is Eirfax, the Dusk Crowned.
It is beneath this threshold that the true purpose of the dungeon becomes increasingly difficult to conceal.
The Imprisoned Old God
Between the seventh and eighth tiers lies the prison of an Old God.

Its placement is not represented correctly on any mortal map. The transition cannot be measured entirely through distance, descent, or conventional geometry. Adventurers may pass near it without finding it, while others may enter its influence without realizing they have crossed a boundary.

completeUnadoptedOperatingProposals.procedure: Action; range 100 feet; V/S/F; Instantaneous. KEEP one nonliving item of at most 500 pounds moved within 100 feet. NEW the source item must be individually perceived within 100 feet and line of effect; choose one precise perceived destination within 100 feet of the caster AND no more than 100 feet from the source item’s anchor. The destination need not have an unobstructed intervening path, but actual transport wards still apply. It must contain the whole actual item/payload at the chosen orientation, with real support at rest; no deliberate unsupported drop, insertion into a body or momentum attack is granted. One connected standalone item or real container plus its complete enclosed noncreature contents is one payload. Count all contents and attached parts toward 500 pounds; selecting a lid, gem, hinge or wall section does not detach it or make a new object. Actual assemblies bolted/built into another structure, locked/secured to an external anchor, implanted in a body, or functioning as a locked restraint are ineligible until actually released. Ordinary loose worn gear or an item merely held can qualify if moving the whole item removes no body part, breaks no external secured connection and violates no exact item/ward restriction. NEW an unwilling actual bearer/custodian holding or wearing it makes WIS against the spell DC; success prevents movement. A willing custodian may expressly waive that save. Multiple real custodians must all be willing or fail their own saves; one success blocks the indivisible transaction. Unattended items need no save. Magical identity or attunement alone is not a general immunity, but source-specific anti-removal rules still govern. No creature or living payload travels inside a container; Undead, Constructs and magically object-shaped creatures remain creatures. A genuine corpse is a nonliving body-object only where the actual life rules establish that state; its old identity, weight, decay and resource restrictions persist. Hidden weight, contents, attachment or arrival ineligibility can defeat a paid cast without revealing which fact caused failure. At resolution recheck the complete payload, custodians, endpoints and support. A failure moves nothing and opens no container. Successful placement is at rest relative to the actual destination support; it does not carry stored impact momentum, activate a device, discharge a trap as an attack or rearrange contents. Actual lawful independent consequences of moving an object remain, but no spell-supplied attack or free Sunder is added. The object’s real ownership, locks, conditions, charges and contents remain unchanged.
completeUnadoptedOperatingProposals.newChoices: NEW both caster-range and displacement limits, actual-perception/path exception, supported whole-item placement, complete container mass, WIS contested custody and explicit secured/restraint exclusions. No partial extraction or creature-as-object conversion.
workedCases: TU4-03-A: A 40-pound chest contains 430 pounds of actual noncreature cargo. The 470-pound whole payload qualifies by mass. Source and destination are each within caster range and 80 feet apart; a legal supported arrival moves the locked chest with the same contents and lock, without opening it.

TU4-03-B: The same chest contains another 40 pounds, bringing it to 510, or secretly contains an actual creature. It cannot travel as this payload. A paid failure supplies no free contents/weight readout, and the caster cannot salvage the attempt by sending only a conveniently chosen portion.
completeUnadoptedOperatingProposals.originalQuestion: Preserve any nonliving item up to500lb moved within100ft, Action/100ft/Instantaneous. Define one item versus container/assembly, total payload mass, actual connected parts, attached/worn/held/secured items and contested custody; nonliving does not automatically mean a creature is an object. Specify source and destination knowledge, perception/line of effect, both distance limits, legal volume/support and occupancy. Container contents retain real identity and must satisfy any actual living-payload rule. No duplication, partial-body extraction, automatically bypassed locks/restraints, momentum weapon, mass laundering or interplanar reach is inferred. Paid failed placement and suppression follow explicit transaction rules.

completeUnadoptedOperatingProposals.procedure: KEEP TEN MINUTES,range60feet,V/S/M/F,base10RP and PERMANENT circle UNTIL DISPELLED. NEW choose Create or Rebind. Create requires one perceived fixed horizontal immobile surface within60feet/line of effect supporting an unobstructed10-foot-diameter circle. No imported year-long ritual,gemstone fee or consumed chalk cost is added: the actual material/focus alternative remains,and optional real decorative marks are not free materials. Commit the spell's true costs/cadence at the start; spend ten uninterrupted minutes of actual casting work at that site,remaining within the source range/line. NEW this extended work requires concentration during casting and the caster's Action each own turn in initiative; interruption,incapacity,movement breaking the gate or failed actual damage concentration save loses the work/costs with no partly functional circle. The completed circle itself needs no concentration. Establish one visible magical circular inscription anchored to that actual surface,with a unique immutable creation ID and one custodian initially the creator. A custodian physically at the circle can spend an Action to name a present consenting creature as an additional custodian or remove an existing added custodian; this exact local source permission grants no general identity/location detection. Create may leave the circle unbound as a receiving anchor,or bind one outbound destination to one genuine known existing Teleportation Circle on the SAME plane. NEW knowledge requires ten actual minutes studying that destination's own complete inscription in person,not a guessed identifier,copy of decorative marks,remote photograph or newly invented network address. Its actual custodian must consent to accepting this origin link,recorded by a local Action at the receiving circle once the origin ID exists; until then outbound use is unaccepted and fails. A later local Action by a receiving custodian can close/reopen that origin link or all arrivals. This governs origin links,not an automatic scan of passenger loyalty; ordinary guards,law,ownership and agreements still matter. A custodian at the origin can locally close/reopen outbound use with an Action. Rebind performs this full ten-minute paid cast on an existing circle with its custodian's consent,retaining its identity/incoming links but replacing its single outbound destination only on successful completion; failure leaves the old completed configuration,apart from actual separately resolved damage/removal. Rebinding still needs genuine destination study/acceptance. A complete new replacement circle has a new ID and does not inherit the old links. No one-circle-per-caster limit is added; every independent permanent site requires its real work/payment and persists without the creator's continued life or concentration. NEW activation: one conscious willing creature wholly within the circle and able to understand the act spends its Action to activate that one fixed accepted outbound link. No per-transitRP price,spell knowledge or new cast is required. The creature and its actually legally carried belongings/creatures must fit wholly within the origin and actual carrying limits. Loose cargo cannot trigger transit itself; it must be genuinely carried/handled as that activating traveler's permitted load. The circle can attempt at most one activation per six elapsed seconds,tracked per origin including failed committed attempts; no extra-turn/caster/recipient change bypasses that cooldown. Known cooldown or closed/unbound state fails preflight without an invented charge. At commitment reserve that source opportunity and Action,then recheck origin/destination existence,operative magic,accepted binding and a whole legal receiving space inside or immediately adjacent to the fixed destination circle. Use nearest legal receiving placement with neutral board-order ties,not remote tactical selection or searching through barriers. If either endpoint/placement fails,the whole group stays at origin; spent Action/cooldown remain,no cargo is split and no remote failure diagnosis is given. A valid transit completes atomically,retaining actual identities and current states. An endpoint suppression/destruction/removal before that atomic event prevents it; after completion it cannot strand half a body or reverse arrival. Suppression temporarily disables creation/use as actually applicable and never erases stored ID/configuration; ending suppression restores only a still-existing circle and current permissions/cooldown. Actual eligible rank5dispel ends this circle,not all network sites. Destruction of the supporting surface that breaks the complete circle geometry,or moving the underlying surface to a new site,ends the effect; cosmetic scratches alone are not a new free dispel. No movable carpet/ship circle is produced. A custodian can voluntarily decommission this source with an Action at it. Incoming links to a gone ID become unusable rather than pointing to a newly drawn copy. These are physical same-plane network endpoints with no geographic travel-distance ceiling once linked,an explicit NEW network rule; they grant no planar route,cross-world target discovery,remote sensing,projectile/spell line of effect,automatic extraction/settlement or custody cleansing. Actual approach,arrival hazards,Haven procedures and work/rest clocks remain real.
completeUnadoptedOperatingProposals.newChoices: NEW ten-minute concentration-during-work model,permanent fixed10-foot circle,unique identity/custodians,one studied same-plane outbound link with destination acceptance,paid ten-minute Rebind,Action transit/freeRP and one attempt per six seconds. No year-long ritual or planar network is imported.
workedCases: UN5-05-A: Create unbound circle A, then create B bound toward the actually studied A and have A's custodian accept B. Later the full paid Rebind on A can point toward a genuinely studied/accepting B. This needs three actual ten-minute casts at base 10 each: 30 minutes of casting and 30 RP, plus the actual destination-study and acceptance work. Each activation thereafter still needs real accepted endpoints and whole-body placement.

UN5-05-B: A traveler commits an activation but the destination becomes suppressed before transit resolves. The whole group stays at the origin with its real gear,and the Action/six-second origin opportunity remains spent. A successful completed transit is not cut in half by later dispelling,and a new circle drawn at a destroyed site receives a different ID rather than inheriting old incoming routes.
completeUnadoptedOperatingProposals.originalQuestion: Preserve creating a PERMANENT teleportation circle,Core10MINUTES/60ft/UNTIL DISPELLED,10RP. Resolve permanent versus until dispelled as an actual persistent object/effect model,without replacing the printed ten-minute cast by an imported year-long ritual. Give finite footprint,surface/placement,material requirements and exact component consumption where NEW; establish operational activation,users,destination/network binding,knowledge/authorization,capacity,cadence and cost. Creation is distinct from each transport: each needs real bodies,carried gear,legal receiving space and atomic occupancy/custody handling. Address dispel/suppression during transit,moving/damaging the surface,duplicate identifiers and decommissioning without stranded copies or free unspecified destinations. This is a local mechanical network question; any cross-plane connection remains deferred to cosmology and must not be inferred from permanent.

semanticFindings: Matrix P92 permits escape magic to Floor1 but says it ends the current descent. This is original-source narrative, not a license to overwrite the separately reviewed expedition/extraction procedures. Exact live comparison remains required.
Matrix P94/P99/P109/P114/P119/P135 guardian ordering differs from July Q7 live roster. A cosmology reading must not re-promote that source ordering as current play data.
Matrix P139–140 places an Old God between tiers7/8 with nonordinary geometry. Preserve this alongside World P7 Floor97 and current Director distinction; no identity merger.
The twelve read current catalog cards are operationally null. Eight central transit dependencies plus Blink, Banishment and two Planar Summons variants are still unresolved in operational scope.

Teleport Object and Teleportation Circle have complete unadopted procedures with two examples each. Circle same-plane network choices are explicitly NEW; they do not settle cross-plane routes. A comparison attachment does not equal dedicated spell acceptance.

Teleport and Ethereal Disjunction have source questions but no complete procedure in the higher-rank index; Plane Shift, Planar Gate, Astral Projection, Etherealness, Banishment and both Planar Summons variants have literal receipts only. Blink is outside that higher-rank index and remains separately recorded as receipt-only-post-push-cosmology.

No core default action/range/duration is adopted as a newly verified individual spell procedure. No new planar reach, route, entity identity, dungeon bypass, summoning body, cost or flag is introduced.
